intended_message: We should pause new sales hiring to cover support burn

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: I think we need to hold that sales hire and use the cash to get help for support, we're drowning.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: I get it, support is slammed, but I disagree on freezing the hire, if we don't have someone on pipeline we'll stall by spring.

turns.speaker: wearer
turns.text: But if churn keeps up like this, more sales just means more angry customers.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Totally fair concern, I just think the fix is me covering support part-time while the rep ramps, not pausing growth.
